in_sanskrit.name: नरेन्द्रासिंह
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who possesses the inner qualities of a lord and is the master of men.

in_hindi.name: नरेंद्रसिंह
in_hindi.long_meaning: The supreme master of all men.

in_marathi.name: Narendrasingh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Men
in_marathi.long_meaning: Narendrasingh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Narendra means 'Lord of Men', while Singha is a lion, a symbol of power, strength, and courage. Therefore, Narendrasingh means 'Lord of Men, Lion King'.

in_bengali.name: Narendrasingh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Men
in_bengali.long_meaning: Narendrasingh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Narendra means 'Lord of Men', while Singha is a lion, a symbol of power, strength, and courage. Therefore, Narendrasingh means 'Lord of Men, Lion King'.
